rows.label: Valheim
rows.hook: drops Viking warriors into a procedurally generated afterlife to build, explore and fight bosses

rows.label: Undertale
rows.hook: lets players spare monsters instead of fighting them in a quirky underground world

rows.label: Geometry Dash
rows.description: 2013 music-based platform video game and video game series
rows.hook: has a sliding cube leaping over spikes in time with a pounding soundtrack

rows.label: Outer Wilds
rows.description: 2019 video game developed by Mobius Digital
rows.hook: traps an explorer in a repeating loop that ends when the sun explodes

rows.label: Among Us
rows.hook: has crewmates doing tasks on a spaceship while hidden impostors sabotage and sneak around

rows.label: Hollow Knight
rows.hook: sends a tiny bug warrior through a ruined underground insect kingdom

rows.label: Stardew Valley
rows.description: 2016 indie farming simulation role-playing video game
rows.hook: has you inheriting a run-down farm and building a new life in a small town

rows.label: Flappy Bird
rows.description: 2013 mobile video game by Dong Nguyen
rows.hook: had players tapping to keep a winged character between green pipes, and became famously frustrating

rows.label: Terraria
rows.hook: lets players dig, build and fight bosses in a 2D sandbox world

rows.label: Hades
rows.description: 2020 action role-playing game developed by Supergiant Games
rows.hook: has a rebellious prince repeatedly fighting his way out of the Greek underworld

rows.label: Balatro
rows.hook: turns poker hands into a roguelike where jokers multiply your score

rows.label: Five Nights at Freddy's
rows.hook: has a night security guard surviving jump scares from haunted animatronic mascots at a pizzeria

rows.label: Celeste
rows.hook: follows a girl climbing a treacherous mountain while battling her own anxiety

rows.label: The Stanley Parable
rows.hook: features a sarcastic narrator commenting on an office worker's every choice

rows.label: Cuphead
rows.hook: pairs classic rubber-hose cartoon animation with brutally hard boss fights

rows.label: Stray
rows.description: 2022 adventure video game developed by BlueTwelve Studio
rows.hook: puts you in the paws of a cat wandering a neon-lit city of robots

rows.label: Dwarf Fortress
rows.hook: simulates a mountain colony of tiny bearded miners, famous for chaotic stories and a steep learning curve

rows.label: Slay the Spire
rows.hook: blends deck-building card battles with a roguelike climb up a tower

rows.label: Subnautica
rows.description: 2018 survival action-adventure video game developed by Unknown Worlds Entertainment
rows.hook: strands you on an alien ocean planet to survive and explore underwater

rows.label: Dead Cells
rows.hook: combines roguelike runs with fast Metroidvania exploration through a shifting castle

rows.label: Factorio
rows.hook: has you building sprawling automated production lines on an alien planet

rows.label: Dave the Diver
rows.hook: mixes ocean exploration by day with running a sushi restaurant by night

rows.label: Human: Fall Flat
rows.hook: has wobbly, physics-driven characters stumbling through dreamlike puzzle worlds

rows.label: Journey
rows.hook: has a robed traveler crossing a desert toward a glowing mountain alongside anonymous partners

rows.label: Untitled Goose Game
rows.hook: lets you play a mischievous honking pest tormenting the residents of a quiet village
